summary: Iteration 21: tested the staff profile, check-in follow-up tasks, certificate reminder history and the starter welcome. Backend: all 16 pytest checks passed. GET /api/staff/{id}/profile returns 403 for employees, 404 for unknown users, and the full shape for admins (starter is null for groups that are not New Starter). 'Follow-up needed' creates exactly two tasks that share one group_id (starter and admin), due today+7, with the notes as the description. Saving again, or changing the outcome away and back, does not create another; 4 saves sent at the same moment also produced only one group. Other outcomes create no task. send_cert_reminders was called in-process with notify and send_email mocked; the log has the right shape and is returned newest first without _id. PATCH group to new_starter_employee sets welcome_sent_at and creates one 'Welcome to the team!' notification. Switching groups again does not re-send. The in-process welcome email (mocked) has the right recipient, subject, escaped name and the ordered checklist. Frontend at 390x844 as admin: Team 'Profile' opens /staff/{id} with the stats and all four sections. The Compliance 'Reminder history' link opens the empty state. Expanding a compliance row shows 'View profile', which navigates correctly. On /starter/user_testemp001, booking a check-in and saving 'Follow-up needed' notes shows the toast 'Notes saved. A follow-up task due in 7 days was added for you both.' A re-save shows 'Check-in notes saved'. The profile check-in history shows the outcome and notes, and the starter button navigates. No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages in the reviewed files.

minor.issue: The task due date uses date.today(), which is the server date in UTC, not DIGEST_TZ (Perth). Before 8am Perth time the due date is one day earlier than the admin expects. Reference: /app/backend/routes/compliance.py:385

Both check a flag and then write it, which is not atomic. In practice a 4-way concurrent save still made only one group. An atomic claim (update_one with followup_group_id/welcome_sent_at $exists:false, then check modified_count) would make the single-send guarantee robust. Reference: /app/backend/routes/compliance.py:376,396-398
notes, outcome and notes_by are now stripped (the iteration 20 fix is verified). followup_group_id is still returned to the employee. This is harmless but inconsistent; consider stripping it too.

issues: With 30 policies the Policies section is very long, which pushes Check-in history far down. Consider showing only pending policies, or collapsing the section with a 'Show all' toggle.
Reminder history rows show only the date (formatDate) and not the time it went out.
The 'Profile', 'Set group' and role buttons (smallBtn) are 36px tall, below the 44px touch target (team.tsx:145).
The outcome chips are still 36px tall (below 44px).
The cancel check-in trash icon still deletes straight away with no confirmation (carried over from iteration 20).

action_items: Optional: compute the follow-up due date in DIGEST_TZ (datetime.now(DIGEST_TZ).date() + 7 days).
Optional: make the follow-up and welcome single-send claims atomic (conditional update_one, then check modified_count).
Optional: strip followup_group_id from employee GET /api/events.
Design: 44px touch targets for the Team small buttons and the outcome chips; add a confirm before cancelling a check-in; consider collapsing long policy lists on the staff profile.
Data: leftover seed user user_TEST_third01 (TEST_third@example.com, not hidden) shows in the Team and Compliance lists. Delete it or set hidden=true.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.py: admin_user guard, 404 and projection P are correct. Check-ins include admin notes, which is fine because the endpoint is admin-only.
create_followup uses a local import of create_task with the admin as creator. Notifications go only to the non-creator (the starter). Correct.
send_cert_reminders now logs before sending, so a log is written even if sending fails partway. This is acceptable.
set_staff_group calls spawn(send_starter_welcome) on every group change. This is cheap because the function returns early, but it could be skipped when the new group is not a New Starter group.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Cleanup done: follow-up tasks, test check-ins, notifications for the test emp/admin since the test start, and TEST_ reminder logs deleted (the reminder log collection is empty). The in-process fake user was deleted. user_testemp001 was set back to staff_group null and hidden=true, and welcome_sent_at/starter_completed_at were unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. Never call POST /compliance/remind-certificates without preview=true. Test in-process with motor (a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient per asyncio.run) and patch rc.db/rcert.db/notify/send_email. The team list hides user_testemp001 (hidden), so use /starter/user_testemp001 and /staff/user_testemp001 directly. The check-in date field is dd-mm-yyyy. The server date is in Oct 2026.
